summary: Magic Empire Global Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing proxy materials for a Class B meeting and an extraordinary general meeting scheduled for July 22, 2026. The proposals include varying Class B share rights to grant 100 votes per share (vs. 1 vote for Class A and none for non-voting shares) and increasing authorized shares to 600M. Neither proposal involves a transaction (such as an acquisition, divestiture, or going-private), a strategic review, or a forced management change. The filing is a routine corporate governance notice to amend capital structure and voting rights, not a special situation event.
